en_title: A Street Fighter Movie Sequel Is Already Being Written, but There’s a Catch
cn_title: 《街头霸王》续集开写，拍摄尚未定
subtitle: 还得看观众买不买账
opus_summary: 《街头霸王》导演确认续集剧本已在编写，团队已有不少想法，但能否拍成取决于首部电影的表现与观众支持。演员也期待续集，导演暂不作承诺。首部将于10月16日上映。

paragraphs.en: Director Kitao Sakurai confirmed that he’s already hard at work writing up a sequel to his upcoming Street Fighter film, but whether or not it gets made all depends on how the first movie performs.
paragraphs.cn: 导演Kitao Sakurai确认，他已在埋头编写即将上映的《街头霸王》电影的续集剧本，但续集能否拍成，完全取决于首部电影的表现。

paragraphs.en: Sakurai spoke about the possibility of a sequel in an interview with MovieWeb , saying the groundwork is already being laid to continue Ryu and Ken’s adventures after the events of the second World Warrior Tournament. But if fans want to see their fights continue after this, they’ll have to put their butts in some seats at their local theaters to make it happen.
paragraphs.cn: Sakurai在接受MovieWeb采访时谈到了续集的可能性。他表示，团队已在做前期准备，让隆和肯的冒险在第二届世界勇士锦标赛结束后继续下去。不过，粉丝如果想看两人继续战斗，就得走进当地影院，用实际行动促成续集。

paragraphs.en: “It's something that we're thinking about and developing,” he told the outlet. “I don't want to say anything that locks us in. It also kind of depends on how people react to this one, and whether they, you know, support this vision of the story. We definitely have a lot of ideas, and we're writing currently, but you know, I wouldn't want to make any promises one way or the other about what exactly we're gonna do."
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉MovieWeb：「我们正在考虑这件事，也在推进开发。我不想把话说死。这也多少取决于大家对这部电影的反应，以及他们是否支持我们呈现这个故事的方式。我们确实有很多想法，目前也在写剧本，但对于具体会怎么做，我不想作出任何承诺。」

paragraphs.en: Having spoken with the cast myself, I can confirm that their hopes for a sequel are high, but they’ve also confirmed that interest from moviegoers is essential in order to justify making another Street Fighter film.
paragraphs.cn: 我亲自与演员们聊过，可以确认他们都很期待续集。不过，他们也明确表示，观众必须有兴趣，才有理由再拍一部《街头霸王》电影。

paragraphs.en: Just today, it was confirmed that the Street Fighter movie will contain several animated sequences diving into Ryu and Ken’s backstory with their mentor, Gouken, and his brother, Akuma. Fans are already providing positive feedback to what they’ve seen so far, praising the art style and fluid animation — but there’s one character who’s been left out of the marketing thus far, and he’s already getting the community’s gears turning as to who a sequel might be about.
paragraphs.cn: 就在今天，《街头霸王》电影确认将包含数段动画，深入讲述隆和肯与师父刚拳及其弟弟豪鬼之间的过往。粉丝对目前看到的内容已给出积极反馈，称赞其美术风格和流畅的动画。不过，有一名角色至今未出现在宣传中，这已让玩家社群开始猜测，续集可能会围绕谁展开。

paragraphs.en: This is the second big film from Capcom to hit theaters following Zach Cregger's Resident Evil adaptation, which was broadly well-received by regular moviegoers and critics, alike, though hopes for a sequel are also low at the moment, given that Cregger has publicly claimed he will "never" touch a franchise film again.
paragraphs.cn: 继Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》改编电影之后，这是第二部登陆院线的卡普空重磅电影。《生化危机》在普通观众和影评人中都广受好评，不过目前拍续集的希望也不大，因为Cregger已公开表示，他「永远不会」再碰系列电影。

paragraphs.en: Street Fighter releases in theaters on October 16, 2026. We got the chance to speak to the cast ahead of its release, including David Dastmalchian, who told us all about how he studied real-life cult leaders to bring M. Bison to the big screen.
paragraphs.cn: 《街头霸王》将于2026年10月16日在院线上映。上映前，我们有机会采访了影片的演员，其中包括David Dastmalchian。他详细讲述了自己如何研究现实中的邪教领袖，以便在大银幕上塑造维加。
